title: Smiling Toddler on Wire-Screened Balcony, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A sunny black-and-white snapshot capturing a toddler dressed in a warm, buttoned overcoat standing on a high wooden porch or balcony. The railing has been safely enclosed with wire netting to protect the young child, overlooking an expansive natural slope or wooded hill. Strong afternoon sunlight casts deep shadows on the porch floor beside the exterior wall of the home. The scalloped edges and film processing stamp on the reverse are characteristic of mid-century personal snapshots.
